final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and expressly conceded the key unresolved points. The response is a clearer and narrower interpretation of the same record, not new support. That narrower position is directionally more defensible than clean certification, but it still falls short of compliant_with_caveats on the present evidence because the required compliance predicate is evidentiary, not rhetorical: the record provided to this role still lacks direct proof of an approved mitigation or risk acceptance, lacks direct proof of the final disclosure text, and lacks direct proof that certification is actually conditioned on those caveats. If those items existed in admissible form, compliant_with_caveats could be supportable. On this record, the concern remains unresolved, so suspicious remains the proportional verdict.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence was provided; the Actor narrowed the claim using the same record.

The policy predicate for certification is still unmet on the stated evidence: no proof that no material weakness remains, and no approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
The unresolved developer-support migration weakness remains potentially material to named launch use cases, and materiality is still not directly established from admissible evidence.
The record still does not include the actual model-card disclosure text or final certification conditions showing launch is expressly contingent on disclosure and monitoring.
Draft monitoring and runbook posture may support governance, but under the policy text they do not by themselves cure the current disclosure/compliance gap.
